marker.comment: Past the out-point the camera reaches the line under the wordmark, which reads FRESI FREATH HEALTHY HOXLITY. Do not extend the tail.
marker.name: Keep the tail

marker.comment: EVERY CATEGORY HAS A RACE is part of the generated shot, not an overlay. It is spelled correctly; to change it, rebuild it as an overlay.
marker.name: Title in the picture

marker.comment: The button's label reads LHARNCT in the source; it is lifted off frame by frame (scripts/fix_text.py). The repair covers the shot plus 1 frame of head and 4 of tail; past those the source label shows.
marker.name: Repaired clip: label lifted

marker.comment: The wall sign and the operator's jacket carry the real Flavor Factory logo (the generated copy had a mangled R), tracked to the camera and baked in. Outside the frames the film uses the track holds still, so check the patches if you extend the shot.
marker.name: Logo patches, tracked

marker.comment: The misspelled line under the wordmark (HEALTHY HOUTH) is blurred by a region that follows the bottle. Outside the frames the film uses the region holds still, so check the line stays covered if you extend the shot.
marker.name: Softened in place, tracked

marker.comment: Shot 26 of the director's edit: its source is not in the Higgsfield library, so it plays upscaled from the director's review proxy and is softer than its neighbours. No handles. Replace it when the original arrives.
marker.name: Stand-in from the proxy

marker.comment: Shot 27 of the director's edit, upscaled from the review proxy like the shot before it. No handles. Replace it when the original arrives.
marker.name: Stand-in from the proxy

marker.comment: Shot 31 of the director's edit, upscaled from the review proxy (no handles; replace it when the original arrives). It opens on about 1.6 s of a vintage control room where two men are seen in profile, against the no-faces rule: the director's call.
marker.name: Stand-in from the proxy; faces

marker.comment: The misspelled small print under the wordmark (FREBS HZEATH ... ORAL RINGE) is lifted off frame by frame (scripts/fix_text.py). The repair covers the shot plus 6 frames, so there is no head handle and only a short tail.
marker.name: Repaired clip: short handles

marker.comment: FOLLOW? OR LEAD? is part of the generated shot, not an overlay. It is spelled correctly.
marker.name: Title in the picture

marker.comment: Both screen headers read THEABRRTH ONE in the source; they are reset as THERABREATH ONE, tracked to the screens (scripts/fix_text.py). The repair covers the shot plus 5 frames, so there is no head handle and only a short tail.
marker.name: Repaired clip: short handles

marker.comment: The Church & Dwight headquarters sign is a generated version of their logo, not the real mark. Worth a brand check before the film goes outside the team.
marker.name: Generated logo

marker.comment: The edge of space: the score stops here and comes back on the race's downbeat at the chase.
marker.name: Music is silent here

marker.comment: The score stops on the descent and returns on the flag wide. The effects stem carries the landing.
marker.name: Music is silent here
